headline: Backup Report for Travis County Homes
summary: Travis County has an elevated risk of long power outages. Records from the past 8 years since 2018 show a long outage about once every 10 years. In February 2021, 43% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 96 hours. In February 2023, 29% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 132 hours. One Core lasts about 18 hours in August. One Core lasts about 44 hours in February. Two Cores are suggested. Two Cores cover 90% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
